headline: Claude Code deployment costs plummet as enterprises scale AI agent automation
body: A real-world case study demonstrates running 17 Claude Code bots costs under $100 monthly, while Revolut achieved 10x cost reduction by shifting to self-hosted solutions. This pricing efficiency is reshaping healthcare AI economics for clinical automation use cases. For vendors and consultants, the cost-per-bot-per-month metric now enables ROI models for EHR integration tasks, prior authorization workflows, and documentation automation that were previously cost-prohibitive. However, the recent departure of Claude Code's product lead and security concerns flagged in enterprise deployments signal that healthcare organizations need careful evaluation of governance and compliance frameworks before deploying multi-agent systems in regulated environments.
